```{r}

foldername <- 'CoOp/'

runlabel <- '32 Houses'


filename <- paste0(foldername,'indata1.xlsx')
mixeddata <- read_excel(filename, sheet='Results')

mixeddata_1b <- mixeddata

costs <- mixeddata[1:4,1:2]
names(costs) <- c('Cost_Type', 'Dollars')
costs$Scenario <- runlabel
costs_1b <- costs


i_tech <- mixeddata[1:2, 5:27]
names(i_tech) <- c(1:23)
#flips rows and columns (transpose)
i_tech <- as.data.frame(t(i_tech))

names(i_tech) <- c('Technology', "Capacity")
rownames(i_tech) <- NULL

#formatting columns as correct class
i_tech$Technology <- as.character(i_tech$Technology)

#since this is a factor have to convert it to a character before converting it to a number
i_tech$`Capacity` <- as.numeric(as.character(i_tech$`Capacity`))




capacity <- i_tech

capacity$Scenario <- runlabel 
capacity_1b <- capacity

#Production of Electricity by Tech

prod_elc <- mixeddata[27:34,5:17]

names(prod_elc) <- c((0:12))
names(prod_elc)[1] <- 'Tech'



prod_elc[,2:13] <- as.data.frame(sapply(prod_elc, as.numeric))[,2:13]
#prod_elc[is.na(prod_elc)] <- '0'

prod_util <- subset(prod_elc, Tech == 'U_ELC1' | Tech == 'U_ELC2' | Tech == 'U_ELC3' | Tech == 'U_ELC4' | Tech == 'U_ELC5')
prod_tech <- subset(prod_elc, !(Tech == '0' |Tech == 'U_ELC1' | Tech == 'U_ELC2' | Tech == 'U_ELC3' | Tech == 'U_ELC4' | Tech == 'U_ELC5'))

eutil_math <- prod_util[,-1]
eutil_math <- colSums(eutil_math)

prod_util[1,2] <- sum(eutil_math)
prod_util[1,1] <- 'Utility'
prod_util <- prod_util[1,1:2]

etech_math <- prod_tech[,-1]
etech_math <- rowSums(etech_math)

prod_tech[,2] <- etech_math

prod_tech <- prod_tech[,1:2]


prod_elc <- rbind(prod_tech,prod_util)
prod_elc_1b <- prod_elc

#Produced Water

prod_water <- mixeddata[47:54,5:17]

names(prod_water) <- c((0:12))
names(prod_water)[1] <- 'Tech'

prod_water[,2:13] <- as.data.frame(sapply(prod_water, as.numeric))[,2:13]
#prod_water[is.na(prod_water)] <- '0'

prod_util <- subset(prod_water, Tech == 'U_H2O1' | Tech == 'U_H2O2' | Tech == 'U_H2O3' | Tech == 'U_H2O4' | Tech == 'U_H2O5')
prod_tech <- subset(prod_water, !(Tech == '0' |Tech == 'U_H2O1' | Tech == 'U_H2O2' | Tech == 'U_H2O3' | Tech == 'U_H2O4' | Tech == 'U_H2O5'))

wutil_math <- prod_util[,-1]
wutil_math <- colSums(wutil_math)



prod_util[1,2] <- sum(wutil_math)
prod_util[1,1] <- 'Utility'
prod_util <- prod_util[1,1:2]

wtech_math <- prod_tech[,-1]
wtech_math <- rowSums(wtech_math)

prod_tech[,2] <- wtech_math

prod_tech <- prod_tech[,1:2]

# Gets the greywater

prod_water1 <- mixeddata[67:70,5:17]

names(prod_water1) <- c((0:12))
names(prod_water1)[1] <- 'Tech'


#prod_water1[is.na(prod_water1)] <- '0'
prod_water1[,2:13] <- as.data.frame(sapply(prod_water1, as.numeric))[,2:13]

prod_water1 <- subset(prod_water1, !(Tech == '0' |Tech == 'U_H2O1' | Tech == 'U_H2O2' | Tech == 'U_H2O3' | Tech == 'U_H2O4' | Tech == 'U_H2O5'))



wtech_math <- prod_water1[,-1]
wtech_math <- rowSums(wtech_math)

prod_water1[,2] <- wtech_math

prod_water1 <- prod_water1[,1:2]

prod_water <- rbind(prod_tech,prod_util,prod_water1)

prod_water_1b <- prod_water

#other data
other <- mixeddata[6:10,1:2]
names(other) <- c('Data_Type', 'Value')
other <- other[-3,]

frac <- other
frac <- frac[-c(1:2),]
names(frac) <- c('Data_Type', 'Value')

frac$Scenario <- runlabel
frac_1b <- frac


#Curtailment

curt_elc <- mixeddata[77:82,5:17]
names(curt_elc) <- c((0:12))
names(curt_elc)[1] <- 'Tech'

#curt_elc[is.na(curt_elc)] <- '0'
curt_elc[,2:13] <- as.data.frame(sapply(curt_elc, as.numeric))[,2:13]
curt_elc <- subset(curt_elc, !(Tech == '0'))



ctech_math <- curt_elc[,-1]
ctech_math <- rowSums(ctech_math)

curt_elc[,2] <- ctech_math

curt_elc <- curt_elc[,1:2]

curt_elc_1b <- curt_elc

#Curtailment Water

curt_water <- mixeddata[87:92,5:17]
names(curt_water) <- c((0:12))
names(curt_water)[1] <- 'Tech'


#curt_water[is.na(curt_water)] <- '0'

curt_water[,2:13] <- as.data.frame(sapply(curt_water, as.numeric))[,2:13]
curt_water <- subset(curt_water, !(Tech == '0'))


ctech_math <- curt_water[,-1]
ctech_math <- rowSums(ctech_math)

curt_water[,2] <- ctech_math

curt_water <- curt_water[,1:2]

curt_water_1b <- curt_water


#Purchase

purchase <- mixeddata[16:17,5:27]
names(purchase) <- c(1:23)
purchase <- as.data.frame(t(purchase))

names(purchase) <- c('Data', 'Value')
rownames(purchase) <- NULL

#formatting columns as correct class
purchase$Data <- as.character(purchase$Data)

#since this is a factor have to convert it to a character before converting it to a number
purchase$Value <- as.numeric(as.character((purchase$Value)))

purchase_1b <- purchase

demand <- mixeddata[107:108, 5:17]

names(demand) <- c((0:12))
names(demand)[1] <- 'Fuel'

demand[,2:13] <- as.data.frame(sapply(demand, as.numeric))[,2:13]

demand$Scenario <- runlabel

demand_1b <- demand


```

```{r}
demandt <- as.data.frame(t(demand_1b))
demandt
demandt <- demandt[-1,]
demandt <- demandt[-13,]
demandt$month <- c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec" )
demandt$elabel <- rep('kWh',12)
demandt$wlabel <- rep('Gal',12)
names(demandt) <- c('kWh', 'Gal', 'Month', 'elabel', 'wlabel')
demandt$kWh <- as.numeric(as.character(demandt$kWh))
demandt$Gal <- as.numeric(as.character(demandt$Gal))


demande_graph <- ggplot() + geom_line(data = demandt, aes (x = Month, y = kWh), group = '')+theme_minimal()+
   labs(title = 'Monthly Energy Demand 32 Houses', x = 'Month', y = 'kWh')

demande_graph1 <- ggplot() + geom_bar(data = demandt, aes (x = Month, y = kWh , fill = elabel), stat = "identity")+theme_minimal()+
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec" ))+
  labs(title = 'Monthly Energy Demand 32 Houses', x = 'Month', y = 'kWh')


demandw_graph <- ggplot() + geom_bar(data = demandt, aes (x = Month, y = Gal , fill = wlabel), stat = "identity")+theme_minimal()+
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec" ))+
  labs(title = 'Monthly Water Demand 32 Houses', x = 'Month', y = 'Gallons')+scale_fill_manual(values = 'blue')+
  annotation_custom(tableGrob(demandt[,1]))
```

```{r}


#Lists that are going to be created and store data from each run
costdfco <- data.frame(House=as.numeric(),Dollars=as.numeric())
capacitydfco <- data.frame(Technology=as.character(),Capacity=as.numeric(), House=as.numeric())
fracdfco <- data.frame(Data_Type=as.character(),Value=as.numeric(), House=as.numeric())
purchasedfco <- data.frame(Data=as.character(),Value=as.numeric(), House=as.numeric())
prod_elcdfco <- as.data.frame(prod_elc_1b)
prod_elcdfco <- prod_elcdfco[0,]
prod_waterdfco <- as.data.frame(prod_water_1b)
prod_waterdfco <- prod_waterdfco[0,]
demanddfco <- as.data.frame(demand)
demanddfco <- demanddfco[0,]




i <- 1

while(i<=32){
filename <- paste0(foldername,'indata_',i,'.xlsx')


#Get all raw data
mixeddata <- read_excel(filename, sheet='Results')


#Get cost data

costs <- mixeddata[1:4,1:2]

names(costs) <- c('House', 'Dollars')

costs$Dollars <- as.numeric(costs$Dollars)

costs <- costs[-c(1:3),]



costs$House <- as.numeric(costs$House)

costs[1,1] <- i

costs <- as.data.frame(costs)

costdfco <- rbind(costdfco,costs)


#Get capacity data


i_tech <- mixeddata[1:2, 5:27]
names(i_tech) <- c(1:23)
#flips rows and columns (transpose)
i_tech <- as.data.frame(t(i_tech))

names(i_tech) <- c('Technology', "Capacity")
rownames(i_tech) <- NULL


#formatting columns as correct class

i_tech$Technology <- as.character(i_tech$Technology)
i_tech$`Capacity` <- as.numeric(as.character(i_tech$Capacity))

i_tech$House <- as.numeric(i)

capacity <- as.data.frame(i_tech)

#Gets rid of Utility
#i_tech <- i_tech[1:13,]

capacitydfco <- rbind(capacitydfco,capacity)

#Production of Electricity by Tech

prod_elc <- mixeddata[27:34,5:17]

names(prod_elc) <- c((0:12))
names(prod_elc)[1] <- 'Tech'



prod_elc[,2:13] <- as.data.frame(sapply(prod_elc, as.numeric))[,2:13]
#prod_elc[is.na(prod_elc)] <- 0

prod_util <- subset(prod_elc, Tech == 'U_ELC1' | Tech == 'U_ELC2' | Tech == 'U_ELC3' | Tech == 'U_ELC4' | Tech == 'U_ELC5')
prod_tech <- subset(prod_elc, !(Tech == '0' |Tech == 'U_ELC1' | Tech == 'U_ELC2' | Tech == 'U_ELC3' | Tech == 'U_ELC4' | Tech == 'U_ELC5'))

eutil_math <- prod_util[,-1]
eutil_math <- colSums(eutil_math)

prod_util[1,2] <- sum(eutil_math)
prod_util[1,1] <- 'Utility'
prod_util <- prod_util[1,1:2]

etech_math <- prod_tech[,-1]
etech_math <- rowSums(etech_math)

prod_tech[,2] <- etech_math

prod_tech <- prod_tech[,1:2]


prod_elc <- rbind(prod_tech,prod_util)
prod_elcdfco <- rbind(prod_elcdfco,prod_elc)

#Produced Water

prod_water <- mixeddata[47:55,5:17]

names(prod_water) <- c((0:12))
names(prod_water)[1] <- 'Tech'

names(prod_water1)[1] <- 'Tech'
```

```{r}
elc_produced <- as.data.frame(mixeddata_1b[118:2757,5:18])

storage_produced <- as.data.frame(mixeddata_1b[40118:42000,5:18])

head(elc_produced,20)

head(storage_produced,20)

elc_produced[is.na(elc_produced)] <- 0

storage_produced[is.na(storage_produced)] <- 0

elc_produced[,8] <- as.numeric(elc_produced[,8])

storage_produced[,8] <- as.numeric(storage_produced[,8])


timeslices <- as.data.frame(elc_produced[2:744,2])

timeslices$hour <- seq(as.POSIXct("2016-06-01 00:00:00"),as.POSIXct("2016-07-01 22:00:00"),by="hour")

names(timeslices) <- c('timeslice', 'hour')

elc_produced$hour <- 0

elc_June <- as.data.frame(elc_produced[,c(1,2,8,15)])

storage_June <- as.data.frame(storage_produced[,c(1,2,8)])



colnames(elc_June) <- c('Technology', 'Timeslice', 'Production', 'Hour')

colnames(storage_June) <- c('Technology', 'Timeslice', 'Production')


elc_June$Hour <- timeslices$hour[match(elc_June$Timeslice, timeslices$timeslice)]

elc_June$Production[is.na(elc_June$Production)] <- 0

elc_June$Timeslice[is.na(elc_June$Timeslice)] <- 0

elc_June$Technology[is.na(elc_June$Technology)] <- 0





storage_June$Production[is.na(storage_June$Production)] <- 0

storage_June$Timeslice[is.na(storage_June$Timeslice)] <- 0

storage_June$Technology[is.na(storage_June$Technology)] <- 0

storage_June <- subset(storage_June, Technology == 'C_BAT')


#subtracting C_BAT production from storage added

elc_June1 <- subset(elc_June, Technology != 'C_BAT')

elc_June2 <- subset(elc_June, Technology == 'C_BAT')

elc_June2$Storage <- storage_June[match(elc_June2$Timeslice, storage_June$Timeslice),3]

elc_June2$Storage[is.na(elc_June2$Storage)] <- 0

elc_June2$Production <- elc_June2$Production - elc_June2$Storage



if(nrow(elc_June2) >= 5){
for(i in 1:nrow(elc_June2)){
  if(elc_June2[i,3] < 0){
    elc_June2[i,1] <- 'Charging'
  }
}
}
```

```{r}
#Making a total cost dataframe
costdf <- as.data.frame(costdfco)
costdf$Scenario <- 'Individual'
costdf <- costdf[,-c(1)]

#Cost of co optimized indivudals summed

costdf[1,1] <- mean(costdfco$Dollars)


#the total costs of the community co-op 1 block solution
costdf[2,1] <- costs_1b[4,2]/32
costdf[2,2] <- '32 Houses'

#the total costs of the community co-op 10 block solution
costdf[3,1] <- costs_10b[4,2]/320
costdf[3,2] <- '320 Houses'

#the total costs of the community co-op 100 block solution
costdf[4,1] <- costs_100b[4,2]/3200
costdf[4,2] <- '3200 Houses'

#deletes unnessary rows
costdf <- costdf[1:4,]

#Fraction Data
fracdf <- as.data.frame(fracdfco)
fracdf <- fracdf[,-c(3)]
fracdf$Scenario <- 'Individual'

#adding individual values

fracdf[,2][is.na(fracdf[,2])] <- 0
fracdf[1,2] <- mean(subset(fracdf,Data_Type == 'Electricity Fraction')[,2]) 
fracdf[2,2] <- mean(subset(fracdf,Data_Type == 'Water Fraction')[,2]) 

#adding community values 1 block
fracdf[3,2] <- frac_1b[1,2]
fracdf[4,2] <- frac_1b[2,2]
fracdf[3:4,3] <- '32 Houses'

#adding community values 10 block
fracdf[5,2] <- frac_10b[1,2]
fracdf[6,2] <- frac_10b[2,2]
fracdf[5:6,3] <- '320 Houses'

#adding community values 100 block
fracdf[7,2] <- frac_100b[1,2]
fracdf[8,2] <- frac_100b[2,2]
fracdf[7:8,3] <- '3200 Houses'



#deleteing unneccessary rows
fracdf <- fracdf[1:8,]

#Adding capacity values

capacitydf <- aggregate(Capacity ~ Technology, data = capacitydfco, FUN = sum, na.rm = TRUE, na.action = NULL)
capacitydf$Scenario <-  'Individual'

capacity_1b$Scenario <- '32 Houses'

capacity_10b$Scenario <- '320 Houses'

capacity_100b$Scenario <- '3200 Houses'
```

```{r}
#combining or removing utility information as neccessary

water_capacitydf <- subset(water_capacitydf, Technology == "H_RW" | Technology == 'C_VRF' | Technology == 'H_RWTANK'  | Technology == 'H_GW' | Technology == 'C_RWTANK')

elc_capacitydf <- subset(elc_capacitydf, Technology == 'C_BAT' | Technology == "H_BAT" | Technology == 'C_HB' | Technology == 'C_PV' | Technology == 'C_WND' | Technology == 'H_PV')

purchasedf <- subset(purchasedf, !(Data == 'U_ELC1' | purchasedf$Data == 'U_ELC2' | purchasedf$Data == 'U_ELC3' | purchasedf$Data == 'U_ELC4' | purchasedf$Data == 'U_ELC5'   | purchasedf$Data == 'U_H2O1' | purchasedf$Data == 'U_H2O2' | purchasedf$Data == 'U_H2O3' | purchasedf$Data == 'U_H2O4' | purchasedf$Data == 'U_H2O5'))

prod_elcdf <- subset(prod_elcdf, !(Tech == 'H_BAT' | Tech == 'C_BAT'))

prod_waterdf <- subset(prod_waterdf, !(Tech == 'H_RWTANK' | Tech == 'C_RWTANK'))

#Subtracts Curtailment (ELC)
#Note have to manually track the elc curtailment for individual runs, assumed they wouldn't curtail



for(i in 1:nrow(prod_elcdf)){

if(nrow(curt_elc_1b) > 0){
for(j in 1:nrow(curt_elc_1b)){
  
  if(curt_elc_1b[j,1] == prod_elcdf[i,1] & prod_elcdf[i,3] == '32 Houses'){
    prod_elcdf[i,2] <- prod_elcdf[i,2] - curt_elc_1b[j,2]
  }
}
}
  
if(nrow(curt_elc_10b) > 0){  
for(j in 1:nrow(curt_elc_10b)){
  
  if(curt_elc_10b[j,1] == prod_elcdf[i,1] & prod_elcdf[i,3] == '320 Houses'){
    prod_elcdf[i,2] <- prod_elcdf[i,2] - curt_elc_10b[j,2]
  }
}
}

if(nrow(curt_elc_100b) > 0){  
for(j in 1:nrow(curt_elc_100b)){
  
  if(curt_elc_100b[j,1] == prod_elcdf[i,1] & prod_elcdf[i,3] == '3200 Houses'){
    prod_elcdf[i,2] <- prod_elcdf[i,2] - curt_elc_100b[j,2]
  }
}
}
  
if(foldername == 'Limited_Utility/'){  

  
  if(prod_elcdf[i,1] == 'H_PV' & prod_elcdf[i,3] == 'Individual'){
    prod_elcdf[i,2] <- prod_elcdf[i,2] - 14243.17
  }
}


}

#Subtracts Curtailment (Water)
#Note have to manually track the water curtailment for individual runs, assumed they wouldn't curtail

for(i in 1:nrow(prod_waterdf)){

if(nrow(curt_water_1b) > 0){
for(j in 1:nrow(curt_water_1b)){
  
  if(curt_water_1b[j,1] == prod_waterdf[i,1] & prod_waterdf[i,3] == '32 Houses'){
    prod_waterdf[i,2] <- prod_waterdf[i,2] - curt_water_1b[j,2]
  }
}
}
  
if(nrow(curt_water_10b) > 0){  
for(j in 1:nrow(curt_water_10b)){
  
  if(curt_water_10b[j,1] == prod_waterdf[i,1] & prod_waterdf[i,3] == '320 Houses'){
    prod_waterdf[i,2] <- prod_waterdf[i,2] - curt_water_10b[j,2]
  }
}
}

if(nrow(curt_water_100b) > 0){  
for(j in 1:nrow(curt_water_100b)){
  
  if(curt_water_100b[j,1] == prod_waterdf[i,1] & prod_waterdf[i,3] == '3200 Houses'){
    prod_waterdf[i,2] <- prod_waterdf[i,2] - curt_water_100b[j,2]
  }
}
}
  if(foldername == 'Limited_Utility/'){  

  
  if(prod_waterdf[i,1] == 'H_GW' & prod_waterdf[i,3] == 'Individual'){
    prod_waterdf[i,2] <- prod_waterdf[i,2] - 495441.4
  }
  if(prod_waterdf[i,1] == 'H_RW' & prod_waterdf[i,3] == 'Individual'){
    prod_waterdf[i,2] <- prod_waterdf[i,2] - 11953.23
  }
}

  

}

#Divides by the number of houses to get an average per house


for(i in 1:nrow(prod_elcdf)){
  if(prod_elcdf[i,3] == 'Individual' | prod_elcdf[i,3] == '32 Houses'){
    prod_elcdf[i,2] <- prod_elcdf[i,2]/32
  }
  if(prod_elcdf[i,3] == '320 Houses'){
    prod_elcdf[i,2] <- prod_elcdf[i,2]/320
  }
  if( prod_elcdf[i,3] == '3200 Houses'){
    prod_elcdf[i,2] <- prod_elcdf[i,2]/3200
  }
}

for(i in 1:nrow(prod_waterdf)){
  if(prod_waterdf[i,3] == 'Individual' | prod_waterdf[i,3] == '32 Houses'){
    prod_waterdf[i,2] <- prod_waterdf[i,2]/32
  }
  if(prod_waterdf[i,3] == '320 Houses'){
    prod_waterdf[i,2] <- prod_waterdf[i,2]/320
  }
  if( prod_waterdf[i,3] == '3200 Houses'){
    prod_waterdf[i,2] <- prod_waterdf[i,2]/3200
  }
}

if(nrow(purchasedf) >= 1){
for(i in 1:nrow(purchasedf)){
  if(purchasedf[i,3] == 'Individual' | purchasedf[i,3] == '32 Houses'){
    purchasedf[i,2] <- purchasedf[i,2]/32
  }
  if(purchasedf[i,3] == '320 Houses'){
    purchasedf[i,2] <- purchasedf[i,2]/320
  }
  if(purchasedf[i,3] == '3200 Houses'){
    purchasedf[i,2] <- purchasedf[i,2]/3200
  }
}
}
```
